notes.exclusiveTiming: Stack-based exclusiveMs subtracts direct wrapped child call durations from each parent frame. InclusiveMs overlaps across parent/child buckets and must not be summed.
notes.unattributedWallMs: wallMs minus wrappedTopLevelMs includes test setup, object allocation outside wrapped exports, and Vitest expect matchers; it is NOT exact matcher time.
notes.metadataLimitations: Per-step size metadata reads only already-existing canonical strings and array lengths on inputs/outputs. Transient internal canonical strings discarded inside validateDryMaterial (MaterialPlan.baseCanonicalJson), beltReference (BeltStepProposal.baseLineCanonicalJson/inputCanonicalJson/proposalBytes), and productionStep (ProductionProposal intermediate bindings) are not exposed on DryFactoryProposal and are NOT_MEASURED.

notMeasuredBoundaries.reason: ESM intra-module calls (e.g. serializeCanonicalJson/canonicalize inside serialization.ts, local canonicalJson/isImmutableData/validateDryMaterial inside dryFactorySlice.ts, assertView/binding inside reservations.ts, commitFactoryProductionStep internal stepFactoryProduction recomputation inside productionStep.ts, commitFactoryBeltStep internal advanceFactoryBelt recomputation inside beltReference.ts) do not cross module import bindings unless called from an external module.
notMeasuredBoundaries.commitRecomputationNote: Cross-module calls triggered during commitDryFactoryStep/commitFactoryProductionStep/commitFactoryBeltStep/commitFactoryMaterialStep are captured in each commit step's inclusiveByBucketMs and exclusiveByBucketMs; intra-module self-calls remain inside the caller's exclusiveMs.
